outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic icons illustrating image cropping/rotation/resizing alongside example micrographs; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic icons and micrographs illustrating image spacing/separation, not a data plot.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating insets/zooms, not a data plot.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast slider schematic with example grayscale micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows schematic annotation examples (colored circles) and micrographs illustrating channel labeling, not a data plot.
Panel f shows a schematic Venn-like diagram and micrographs illustrating grayscale channel separation, not a data plot.
Panel g shows schematic calibration-scale icons and example micrographs with intensity/pseudocolor scales, not a bar/aggregate data plot requiring individual points.
